sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 9)

purpose.zh: 练腿张开的时候自己还能抬起来，换腿才扫得开
purpose.en: Teaches your legs to lift on their own while spread wide, so they sweep open when you switch.

text.zh: 腿伸直，膝盖脚尖朝天，抬起一条腿离地几厘米
text.en: Legs straight, knees and toes to the ceiling, lift one leg a few centimetres

text.zh: 坐直，背挺起来，屁股可以靠着墙。
text.en: Sit tall with your back straight; you can put your butt against a wall.

text.zh: 手放在屁股两边的地上，就搭着，别用手把自己撑起来。
text.en: Hands on the floor beside your hips, just resting; don't push yourself up with them.

text.zh: 抬起来停两秒，慢慢放下，换另一条腿，左右各一下算 1 次。
text.en: Hold it two seconds, lower it slowly, switch legs; one each side is one rep.

commonErrors.zh: 身体往后仰，或者手撑地把屁股抬起来
commonErrors.en: Leaning back, or pushing through your hands so your hips come up.
Rolling the leg in so the toes tip forward.

cautions.zh: 背挺不直，就屁股靠着墙坐
cautions.en: If you can't keep your back straight, sit with your butt against a wall.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (4 s per side: lift 1 s, hold 2 s, lower 0.9 s, 0.1 s with both legs down; brief: 停 2 秒放下，左右交替)

thomasSupplement.camera: 正前方（看分腿角度和抬起高度）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 3 组 × 每侧 6–10 次，每次停 2 秒
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: 4 s per side (lift 1 s, hold 2 s, lower 0.9 s); sitting tall per the PDF start position (pelvis ~5 deg from vertical, back straight), palms flat on the mat beside the hips, knee caps and toes up. r3: the animation camera is turned 40 deg to the side (the near thigh covers the crotch); the brief asks for a front view.
